title: Inspections.
bodyText: Nothing in this chapter should deprive the several counties of the right to perform electrical or plumbing inspections, as regulated by their respective ordinances.
bodyHtml: [§448E-12]  Inspections.  Nothing in this chapter should deprive the several counties of the right to perform electrical or plumbing inspections, as regulated by their respective ordinances. [L 1971, c 183, pt of §1]
